title: Issue Credit lists a no-charge line's part at a fixed $0.00
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the test location is connected to QuickBooks Online, with Inventory Asset and Cost of Parts mapped on its ShopView Accounts page, and that AccountingHub is not enabled.
  • Have access to the QuickBooks Online company of the test location, so its journal entries can be read.
  • Make sure Goodwill is mapped to account G at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with its own labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced, billable, whose line 2 was No Charge under Goodwill with one stock part, part A, costing $40.00.
  • Note part A's quantity on hand.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Click Issue Credit.
  4. Credit part A.
  5. Open part A in Inventory.
  6. In QuickBooks Online, open the entries for the credit.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The invoice shows.

Step 3:

  • Part A is listed at a $0.00 credit that cannot be edited and with no restocking fee.
  • Under the part's name it reads "No Charge · Goodwill".

Step 4:

  • The credit is saved.

Step 5:

  • Part A's quantity on hand is the noted figure plus 1.

Step 6:

  • An entry debits Inventory Asset $40.00 and credits account G $40.00.
